title: Maria and Her Messages
text:
Maria sends many text messages every day. She writes to her friends in the morning and at night. Yesterday she sent a message to her brother about dinner. He replied in five minutes.

Sometimes text messages are confusing. A short message like 'OK' can sound angry, even when the person is happy. Maria now uses emojis to show her feelings. Her friends say the emojis make her messages clearer.

questions.text: How often does Maria send text messages?
Why might a short message like 'OK' be confusing?
options: Because people can misunderstand its tone
Because it is too long to read
Because it is written in another language

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Maria?
options: She likes communicating with others by message
She prefers calling on the phone

vocabulary.definition: answered a message or a question
small pictures used in messages to show feelings
emotions such as happiness or anger

paragraph_translations: María envía muchos mensajes de texto todos los días. Les escribe a sus amigos por la mañana y por la noche. Ayer le envió un mensaje a su hermano sobre la cena. Él respondió en cinco minutos.

A veces los mensajes de texto son confusos. Un mensaje corto como 'OK' puede sonar enfadado, incluso cuando la persona está contenta. María ahora usa emojis para mostrar sus sentimientos. Sus amigos dicen que los emojis hacen sus mensajes más claros.
